description: Defines the QuicSessionKey class used to identify QUIC sessions, including session identification, privacy, socket tagging, and DNS policies.

classes.name: net::QuicSessionKey
classes.description: Represents a key used to identify QUIC sessions, encapsulating server ID, socket tag, privacy mode, DNS policy, and other session-specific attributes.

methods.name: QuicSessionKey
methods.description: Constructors for creating a QuicSessionKey with various parameters.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Comparison operator to enable ordering of QuicSessionKey objects, needed for std::set.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator to compare two QuicSessionKey objects.

methods.name: CanUseForAliasing
methods.description: Checks if the session key can be used to service requests for another session, ignoring host and port differences.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the host part of the server ID.

methods.name: privacy_mode
methods.description: Returns the privacy mode (enabled or disabled) based on the server ID.

methods.name: server_id
methods.description: Returns the server ID associated with the session key.

methods.name: socket_tag
methods.description: Returns the socket tag associated with the session key.

methods.name: network_anonymization_key
methods.description: Returns the network anonymization key used for the session.

methods.name: require_dns_https_alpn
methods.description: Indicates whether DNS HTTPS ALPN is required.
